sections.text: Oil system of Turbine out of Operation

items:
fill the oil into the central oil 
 handling system .

filter The oil and separate 
 centrifuge .

Remove the un-tightness of the piping and 
 fittings .

Clean the magnetic filters in the system of 
 lubrication oil in front of the bearing stands.
Clean the filters of turbine bearings.
Clean the screens in the main oil tank .
Discharge the mud of the main oil tank .

Check the glands of the oil pumps and their 
 tightening if necessary.
Check The validity of the oil system of turbine.

Check all parts for any worn-out and replace 
 them by new ones.
Replace the oil piping including the fittings of defective fittings.

Remove the impurities and possible residues of 
 water from the dead spaces of the waste piping and the bottoms of the boxes 
 and from the siphon of the turbine and generator connecting system .

Clean oil will be re-pumped into the reserve 
 tank where it is prepared for filling into the turbine oil system .

The oil filling must be send for regeneration 
 and a new filling must be used . (the oil service life is usually 30 35 
 thousand hours)

Test the Oil during the first months of operation 
 , we recommend to check oil at least twice in a shift .

Check regularly water content in oil. For a 
 permanent operation of the set will be allowed 0.2% water in oil. Percentage 
 water content should not exceed max. 1%.

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance stuff should be 
 carrying the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment as
 safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the oil pump motor.
Be sure oil system of turbine must be completely drained.

Cleaning fluid, Manual puller.
Feeler gauge, Dial indicator
Vibrometer, Straight edge,
Rags
